prompt: Here's what I need: first figure out what the current best practices are for short-form product demo videos in 2026 (hook timing, captions, pacing — with sources), then take my raw screen recording demo.mp4 and cut it into a 60s demo with burned-in subtitles following those practices. What skills should I use and in what order? Assess first, don't execute.
assertions: Recommends deep-research (or the session's research skill) for the best-practices phase
Recommends video-use for the editing/subtitles phase
Orders research before editing and states what the research phase hands to the editing phase
Assessment only: does not run searches or edit video; lists at least one rejected candidate
Flags at least one execution blocker or precondition (e.g. demo.mp4 path unverified, target platform/aspect ratio unspecified) without resolving it
